verified_title: JEPA for AI-Native 6G: Predictive Representations and Open Challenges
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2607.09798: JEPA for AI-Native 6G: Predictive Representations and Open Challenges
method_summary: Wireless predictive representations may tokenize time-frequency grids, beams, KPIs, topology graphs and sensing with timing/frequency/modality structure. The paper discusses action-conditioned JEPA, explicit masks for missing/asynchronous observations, probabilistic prediction, out-of-distribution detection, conformal/ensemble uncertainty and fallback.
evidence_and_limits: Roadmap and illustrative beam-management study, rather than complete empirical implementation of every proposed component. It does not establish a common packet-deadline benchmark winner.
